description:
The Divergent Checkout Stores procedure matches what its executable witness proves: the
index conflict a two-sided merge deterministically raises is instructed, the broken repair
pointer is replaced, and the confirming re-run is reachable.

## Background

The divergence-and-recovery journey executed the documented procedure exactly as written and
found three defects. A both-direction divergence merges `.jit/issues/` and `.jit/events.jsonl`
cleanly but deterministically conflicts in `.jit/index.json`, which the page never mentions;
the merge-conflict section the page points at prescribes `jit validate --fix`, which errors on
the conflicted index and reports "No fixes needed" on a hand-resolved stale one while plain
`jit validate` correctly fails; and the promised clean confirming re-run is unreachable while
the linked checkout still lacks the reference-only records, because the merge propagated
records in one direction only. The journey test bridged each gap with the minimal action the
finding-class table already implies; the page states those same actions.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Step 4 instructs the deterministic `.jit/index.json` conflict: resolve it to the union of the ids present under `.jit/issues/` after the merge, and verify with plain `jit validate` rather than `jit validate --fix`.
- [hard] REQ-02: The procedure no longer routes the index conflict to a repair that cannot fix it, and warns that a stale index leaves preserved records invisible to listing and lookup until corrected.
- [hard] REQ-03: The confirming re-run step is reachable: the procedure brings the linked checkout onto the retained branch before the re-run, and the promised clean report follows.
- [hard] REQ-04: The corrected sequence matches the divergence-and-recovery journey test step for step, so the page's instructions and their executable witness cannot drift apart silently; the test is cited from the page's vicinity only if the docs conventions permit dev-facing references, otherwise the correspondence is recorded in the issue.

## Notes

The corrected page keeps its existing structure and scope; this issue changes instructions
that are wrong, not the procedure's shape. The `jit validate --fix` blindness itself is a
product defect tracked separately.
title: Correct the divergent-store recovery procedure
